misiones.resumen: Destroy Doriya's Anti-DropShip defense arrays.
misiones.briefing:
The invasion of Tikonov has begun. Over three hundred DropShips carrying all eight regiments of the Crucis Lancers are continuing a high G burn towards the planet. Our flotilla's aerospace escort has just fought back the Night Rider's Deep-Space Interdiction Force leaving only one more obstacle that we must clear before we can make planetfall.

The Kestrel Lancers have been tasked with destroying a series of anti-Dropship batteries located on Tikonov's first moon, Doriya. These batteries combined with the remaining Night Rider aerospace fighters could do some serious damage to the Lancer's invasion force as they try to breach the planet's atmosphere, so it is imperative that we clear the way for our fellow Lancers.

This war is just beginning, so remember your training, watch each other's backs, and do not overcommit your forces in this opening engagement. We will still need 'Mechs at the ready for when we make planetfall. Let's show the rest of the Crucis Lancers what the new Kestrel Lancers can do!

misiones.resumen: Destroy the Ariana Grenadiers and take control of the city of Gizhiga
misiones.briefing:
Kestrel Lancers,

Thanks to your valiant efforts on Doriya, the entirety of the Crucis Lancers were able to make planetfall with minimal casualties! Since making planetfall, we have learned that the Capellan Confederation Strategic Military Director, Pavel Ridzik is presently on Tikonov leading the Capellan defenders. This bodes incredibly well for our war efforts, as capturing or eliminating Ridzik could end this war before it even starts!

But we can't get ahead of ourselves: the Crucis Lancers' next objective is to take control of major population centers and, most importantly, secure Tikonov's numerous spaceports on the planet. The Sixth and Eighth Crucis will be assigned to take the Capital of Tikograd, the Seventh is dropping to secure the primary Earthwerks Limited BattleMech factories, while the remaining Crucis Lancers units will fan out and take other major population centers around the planet. 

The Kestrel Lancers have been assigned to take the mining town of Gizhiga located high in the Kazan mountain range. Although it is a small township compared to other major population centers, it is an important one as it remains close to major mineral mining operations and has an active spaceport located nearby that is used to ship refined materials off planet. No spaceport is too minor when it comes to planetary conquest so, despite its size, it is still heavily defended.

MIIO intelligence estimates that the entirety of the Ariana Grenadiers has been set to garrison Gizhiga and its surrounding area. The Crucis Lancers aerospace wing plans on bombarding the Grenadiers while they are in the open, which will force them to pull back into the city itself. The Kestrel Lancers will then move on Gizhiga, and clean out whatever Grenadier forces remain after the aerospace jocks are done with them. Our assault will commence in two weeks. Prepare your forces appropriately.

misiones.resumen: Clear out and capture the hidden Earthwerks Limited factory.
misiones.briefing:
Kestrel Lancers, I have an important announcement.

Last night, we received word that Pavel Ridzik has abandoned Tikonov. The Sixth, Seventh, and Eighth Crucis attempted to capture him, but bad weather prevented the aerospace wings from being able to pursue Ridzik's DropShip as he fled the system. Across Tikonov, coordinated resistance to our invasion is beginning to break apart. Remaining CCAF units are fleeing into the wilderness, unable to get to their DropShips now that we have firm control over all of Tikonov's spaceports. 

The capital of Tikograd is in talks with AFFS command to negotiate terms of surrender for the city and many of the major civilian population centers on Tikonov. We are hoping that they will help us broker a surrender from the remaining CCAF forces now trapped on Tikonov.

But until that time, the trapped CCAF forces remain a threat. While our blitzkrieg worked at disrupting their defenses and taking firm control of the system's spaceports, it also allowed for large numbers of Confederation Forces to withdraw into the wilderness where they will undoubtedly regroup en masse.

Thanks to the efforts of the Seventh Crucis and their liberation of the head Earthwerks Limited facilities in Tikograd, we were able to identify a hidden Earthwerks 'Mech production facility deep in the Kazan Mountain Range less than 600 klicks south of our current position. Our liaison with the Ministry of Information, Intelligence, and Operations believes that this will be where the CCAF guerrillas will make an attempt to regroup their forces.

As the closest unit stationed near this hidden facility, Command wants the Kestrel Lancers to move against this installation and capture it before the CCAF are allowed to fortify their position and resupply. Taking this facility should cut the legs out from the remaining Confederation forces in-system, so be sure to bring the biggest 'Mechs you can muster in time for this fight. We will be moving against the facility shortly. Finish the fight strong, Lancers!

misiones.resumen: Advance along the nav point route and clear out hostile forces from planned FOB site
misiones.briefing:
Kestrel Lancers,

We're about to make planetfall onto Tigress. Aerospace sweeps of our targeted LZs show no opposing forces waiting for us. From what the reconnaissance has shown, 'Mech and vehicle forces are currently stationed just outside the largest population centers. It appears that the Capellan defenders will allow us to land on Tigress uncontested. 

We believe they are holding these defensive positions anticipating a blitzkrieg similar to our attack on Tikonov. But that will not be our strategy this time. Unlike Tikonov that had major population centers scattered across the planet, Tigress' primary center of power rests in a concentrated cluster of multiple cities and townships called Sì gè chéngshì, The Four Cities. To control Tigress, we only need to neutralize the Four Cities to bring it under our control.

To do this, the Kestrel Lancers will be dropping 40 klicks north of the city behind a small but dense forest named Yuolor's Grove. Our sister unit, the Third Crucis Lancers, will be landing east of the Four Cities at the base of the Granite Fields Mountains. Both battalions will regroup at our planned forward operating bases and then move to initiate a coordinated pincer strike against the Four Cities. 

Before we can move against the Four Cities, both regiments of Crucis Lancers must secure forward operating bases to prepare for our eventual pincer attack. Our FOB will be located within Yuolor's Grove. Once planet-side you are to advance along the nav point route till you reach our planned location for the FOB and clear out any potential hostiles that may be occupying its location. Provided the Capellan defenders maintain their defensive positions, we should be able to secure our FOB with only marginal enemy resistance expected. Good luck everyone.

misiones.resumen: Destroy all marked generators at the city's central power plant
misiones.briefing:
Lancers, fantastic work demolishing Kerr's Intruders!

Crushing a premier Liao assault command is no easy feat for even the best 'Mech regiments out there. Our success is a testament to all of your hard work and training throughout the past year! A successful ambush like that could have utterly destroyed us, but even with our significant losses, everyone should be proud that they rose to the challenge and fought off oblivion together.

Unfortunately, our brothers and sisters in the Third were not so fortunate. Their battalion have been held close to their DZ by relentless assaults from Warrior House Hiritsu and Laurel's Legion. And to make matters worse, their MIIO liaisons believe that both units are massing their forces with the remaining survivors of Kerr's Intruders to make a play at over running their position.

Marshal Pedroza believes that the Third still has the manpower to hold the line on her own. Leaving our main objective, Sì gè chéngshì, open for assault. We have an opportunity to take the city with minimal bloodshed while the Third holds their line, so once Liao commits to their attack that will be our signal to move against our objective.

Commander, your forces are in better shape than the rest of the Battalion, so you will spearhead an assault against a centralized power plant whose fusion generators power the entire region. Blacking out the region's power will put pressure on Mandrissa Laurel to surrender the planet without further bloodshed. The remaining Lancers will run a support role on this operation securing the perimeter to prevent hostile reinforcements. Good luck.

misiones.resumen: Destroy the marked satellites before the stolen codebooks are transmitted off-planet
misiones.briefing:
Lancers, I won't mince words, we are in a nightmare scenario.

House Hiritsu's elite commandos were able to raid Marshal Pedroza's command center and get away with her battalion's encrypted Ministry of Information, Intelligence, and Operations codebooks. If decrypted, House Liao will be able to decode House Davion wideband com chatter and any transmission sent into any ComStar facility on occupied planetary networks. The entire security of Operation RAT could be in jeopardy. 

Our MIIO liaison believes that the encrypted codebook data packets are now in the hands of the Maskirovka, the Capellan state intelligence service. Our spies have reported that since the start of the war, the Maskirovka have been struggling to keep up and verify the flood of reports and information pouring into Sian every day. The head of the Maskirovka Crisis Team, Justin Xiang, is said to have instigated rules requiring local and regional verification of any new intelligence data before being forwarded to Sian to ensure that verified critical Intel to the capital isn't buried by a mountain of minor unverified reports. Because of this, our MIIO liaison believes that the codebooks will stay on Tigress until they are decoded or verified by some other means. Which means that there is still hope that we can still intercept the Third Crucis' stolen codebooks before they are allowed to transmit them to Sian.

Commander, we cannot allow those codebooks to get off-world. Once we identify the location of the Maskirovka, we will need to act swiftly and eliminate any data relay satellites that can transmit the codebook data packs to a JumpShip, or ComStar. I'll need your unit to be ready at a moment's notice the second we identify where they are holding the codebooks. Prepare your lance for rapid deployment the moment we can verify the facility that is housing the codebooks.

Unfortunately, I will not be able to commit additional forces to reinforce you for this mission, Commander. The Kestrel Lancer's primary objective of bringing the system into the fold has not changed. And for now, House Hiritsu and Laurel's Legion still maintain control of Tigress. I'm trusting that you and Ryana are the only ones capable of getting this done without much support from the rest of the Second Crucis. Don't let us down now, Commander.

misiones.resumen: Investigate the SOS claiming to be the Fifth Syrtis Fusiliers
misiones.briefing:
We're on our final approach to Sarna and I'm still getting nothing on the Davion Command channel. I'm also picking up a large amount of space debris in shallow orbit right outside of Sarna's exosphere. It looks to be the debris of a number of destroyed DropShips or satellites, but they are too small to make out any discernable origin.

Wait a minute…

Commander, I'm just beginning to get a read on the Fifth Syrtis Fusiliers encoded channel… It's incredibly faint… They appear to be sending an SOS…

The message is only a single set of coordinates accompanied by a single repeating text transmission:

"Mayday mayday mayday. This is the Fifth Syrtis Fusiliers calling for assistance from any forces loyal to the Federated Suns. We are in need of assistance at the following coordinates."  

No holovid, no audio, and no declaration of any kind of identification… And the signal on this is so faint that I can't even get a read on anything beyond the text transmission and the coordinates… I don't like this, Commander… I don't like this one bit.

Unfortunately, these coordinates are the only lead we have at finding the Fusiliers. And we need those codebooks and their help, or everything will be lost. If this signal is legitimate, we'll need to assist the Fusiliers and make contact with General Hartstone or Colonel Harkness if we are going to have any hope of completing our mission.

But be extremely cautious, Commander. This has all the makings of a trap to lure Davion loyalists into an ambush. I would not risk our most effective 'Mechs until we have a better idea for what's going on. If it's as bad as it looks, we are going to need to prepare for the long haul.

misiones.resumen: Make contact with the rogue Fifth Syrtis Fusilier survivors
misiones.briefing:
Commander, I've reviewed your message from Marshal Davion. I understand the urgency of your mission, but to be completely honest, the Fusiliers are in no shape to help you out. Most of our unit died when McCarron's Armored Cavalry ambushed us. We've barely kept ourselves alive this past month by salvaging remains as we find them. We aren't in any shape to help out in a straight up fight, let alone track down an enemy spy network on a hostile world.

But not everything is hopeless. You see, we still believe that there may be at least one other pocket of Fusiliers out there, the ones that are said to have attacked ComStar's HPG. We've been hoping that they would respond to our SOS, but with all this damn long-range comms jamming, it's next to impossible to get a signal out. I'm actually amazed that you were able to pick it up. Probably because your DropShip communications gear is much more powerful than your average 'Mech's.

That actually gives me an idea.

If I can give you the transponder codes our 'Mechs and vehicles use in the field, you should be able to track down those responsible for the HPG attack by using the sensors on your Leopard. I don't know what got in their heads to be dumb enough to attack one of ComStar's HPGs, but If they're still alive we all stand a much better chance surviving this if we all work together. Safety in numbers and all that.

If you help us out here, I promise that we'll do our best to support you in completing your mission. I wouldn't worry about those codebooks going anywhere, with the system's HPG down and all commercial DropShips grounded, they wouldn't be able to get those codes off-world even if they wanted to.

misiones.resumen: Destroy the regional Maskirovka headquarters in Sarna City
misiones.briefing:
Commander,

Sorry for my emotions getting the best of me out there. But whoever that smug sonovabitch on the comms was, he definitely knew all the right buttons to press to piss me off. My mood's greatly improved after I've been told we were able to pry him out of his 'Mech alive. We got lucky and he fell unconscious during the battle. We weren't so lucky with his co-conspirators though. Many of them killed themselves before they could be taken into custody. We got a handful of them, but not as many as I would have liked to capture.

Whoever they are, they definitely have top grade intelligence training. Could be Maskirovka or Death Commandos. But honestly, there are some huge holes in that theory. They wanted to trap us here, and attacked the HPG to frame House Davion in the eyes of ComStar. While the broad strokes make sense, other major details don't. They never once called for McCarron's to reinforce them, they have no forms of IDs, they don't act like any Capellan I've ever seen, and most of all, they KNOW things. Things that no Capellan intelligence officer would ever divulge to us.

If I'm being honest, the whole lot of them give me the creeps.

We've put all the survivors under enhanced interrogation and came up with zero answers as to who they are or why they destroyed the HPG. But plenty of seemingly random bits of information regarding Yorinaga Kurita, a Liao counteroffensive, plans for a raid against the New Avalon NAIS campus, and other things that were clearly way too implausible to be true.

Among the random bits of information they did divulge was the location of all Maskirovka facilities on Sarna, and confirmation that they did receive a priority message from Tigress months ago. They claim it's been buried in a sea of thousands of other reports that began flooding into their offices since the fall of Tikonov. These must be your lost codebooks, Commander. If it's true, then the Maskirovka do have it, but don't yet know the value of the content they possess.

Although we didn't find any additional Fusiliers survivors, a deal's a deal, Commander. I'll spare what I can to assist you in a raid against the identified Maskirovka headquarters. It won't be much, but with this new intel, it should hopefully be enough for you to get your job done.

misiones.resumen: Make contact with the Crater Cobras and Screaming Eagles
misiones.briefing:
Congratulations completing your mission, Commander!  My commandos reported that the second the Maskirovka saw infantry investigating their destroyed sites, they initiated protocols to destroy everything, rather than see Confederation secrets fall into our hands. We were able to capture a handful of random data drives for good measure, but I doubt there's anything of immediate value to us on them.

Although your mission for Marshal Davion is now complete, I'm afraid that you're still trapped on Sarna just like the rest of us. Liao forces still maintain air superiority and will destroy your DropShip if you attempt to leave the system, just as they destroyed all of ours.

But not all hope is lost. We just captured a scouting patrol from the local militia and were able to tap into McCarron's comms system. While we know they will change the transmission codes the second they realize one of their patrols are missing, we've learned that McCarron is squarely focused on destroying remnants of the Crater Cobras and Screaming Eagles, the Syrtis Fusiliers' mercenary support battalions for the Sarna campaign.

They're still alive and have been causing The Big Mac nothing but problems for months now. We've used your Leopard's sensors to pinpoint their position through their assigned transponder codes. And we've verified that they are still alive and moving. Although they are too far for us to make radio contact through all of this electromagnetic jamming.

This is the best news we've received since you all arrived to help us. Commander, we'll need you to make initial contact with them. At the moment, their reported location is too far away from any of our Fusiliers to make without abandoning our wounded and prisoners. I'll prep everyone for transport and begin to slowly migrate our surviving personnel in their general direction. Your forces can fly ahead in your DropShip and make initial contact with their forces and plan a rendezvous point for us.

The mercenaries have been moving their forces repeatedly trying to stay one-step ahead of McCarron's Armored Cavalry. Judging by their movements, it appears that they are migrating towards the ruins of a derelict WarShip located deep in northern Jacarlos. This will be the most ideal spot for you to make contact with them.

This might be the last time we see each other Commander, so before you go, I just want to say thanks for everything. You've given all the remaining Fusiliers hope that we'll make it out of all of this, one way or another.

misiones.resumen: Destroy the regional ECM jamming arrays
misiones.briefing:
That sure is some story you got there, Commander. While I am glad to hear that Captain Damu was able to rally a number of survivors from the Fusiliers' ranks, you won't find much sympathy for their plight among my men after what Hartstone pulled.

You see, things went sideways for us the second we arrived in-system. After they heard Maximillian Liao killed their beloved duke, General Hartstone ordered the Fifth Syrtis Fusiliers to charge ahead of our invasion flotilla on a high-G burn that jumped the gun on the agreed upon invasion schedule. They beat us to the planet's surface by two days hoping to satisfy their lust for revenge. All they did was walk face first into a trap that doomed them all. I can still hear the screams they broadcast to us in vain hope that we would save them while we were still over a day away from reaching the planet.

The Screaming Eagles and I decided that, despite the incompetence of Hartstone and the Fusiliers, we could not deviate from our contracted invasion plan. If we packed it up and left for home, we might have lived, but we would never be able to find MRB backed work again. We came to the joint decision that we would drop in-system and fight out McCarron's Armored Cavalry in a protracted guerrilla war and attempt to get a message off-system requesting reinforcements from the Armed Forces of the Federated Suns.

Little did we know that the Capellans had some kind of jamming field that disrupts long-range communications planet-wide. Those bastards kept their jammers off so we could listen to the Fusiliers plead for their lives on our approach in, only to flip the switch and jam our comms the second we hit atmosphere. We've been trying to figure out a way to get a message to the jump point ever since.

Commander, we've spent months scouting out the facilities that the Capellans use to disrupt long-range communications on-planet. But with our numbers, we've always determined that assaulting one was too high-risk. With you here, we may just be able to pull it off. We know the Capellans are gunning for us. So if we pull The Big Mac's attention away from a number of their regional jamming arrays, we should be able to thin their defenses enough to where you can perform a targeted strike and bring those jammers down. It'll be just like GALAHAD. We'll draw them away, you see that the mission gets done.

I'll be straight with you, Commander. This mission is critical to us being able to get a message out of the system. I don't know how much longer any of us can last down here, but if you give us a month or so we can plan for an assault on these jamming facilities. So take your time to prepare your forces, and be ready for anything. We may have a need to deploy in consecutive missions depending on how McCarron's reacts to their jammers being destroyed. So make sure you complete as many repairs and refits as possible before we execute this mission. Godspeed my friend. We'll see you on the other side.

misiones.resumen: Survive McCarron's onslaught until Ardan Sortek's reinforcements arrive
misiones.briefing:
Commander, Captain Damu, we're about to engage in the fight of our lives.

The Capellans must know that if they can't wipe us out before the Heavy Guards touch down on Sarna, it's over for them. Their only hope at maintaining control of the planet will be to utterly destroy our forces so that when Colonel Sortek touches down, they'll have the numbers to fight him back. We've all gone through too much just to lose everything at the end! We need to muster whatever strength we have left and hold the line until Colonel Sortek relieves us.

Gather your best 'Mechs, equipment and 'MechWarriors and meet my Crater Cobra's at the following coordinates. Prepare to give The Big Mac everything you've got!  We did not go through six months of hell just to die on the day that reinforcements arrive! The only thing left to do is hold the line! 

We do that, and we will live to see tomorrow!

misiones.resumen: Defend the decommissioned orbital defense system.
misiones.briefing:
Welcome to Avigait, Commander.

The formation of the Federated Commonwealth will unite House Steiner and House Davion militaries into a single, centralized army. Operation GALAHAD will serve as a wide reaching series of wargames, across multiple systems, which will act as a joint training exercise between forces of the AFFS and the LCAF. While many of these wargames will be pitting the AFFS and LCAF against one another, we also want to train in a series of joint exercises combining the AFFS and LCAF forces into a unified FedCom coalition. 

This is where you come in, Commander. For GALAHAD's Avigait games, FedCom coalition forces will be executing a joint-operation attempting to destroy a decommissioned orbital defense system. You and the Crater Cobras have been assigned to act as the defenders of the installation. Your tasks will be to destroy the invading coalition forces and prevent the destruction of the orbital defense system. 

I'll see you in the field Commander. Give us a good fight.

misiones.resumen: Defeat Ardan Sortek and escape before reinforcements arrive.
misiones.briefing:
Commander,

Beating those uncoordinated highborn whelps back was easy to do with their battlefield infighting, but we should continue to press our momentum against them while we have it. With their pride on the line, I doubt that either Colonel Zaks or Marshal Davion will make the same mistake twice. The next time we face them, I'm willing to bet that their desire to beat us will push aside any grievances they have with each other. 

If I've learned anything from my years fighting for these highborns, it's that when faced with adversity, they tend to vastly overcompensate for their failures. The next time we face them, they will most likely pull all remaining forces together to beat us back now that we have the superior numbers on them.

But kicking their ass in a straight-up fight isn't our mission, eliminating their commander, Ardan Sortek, is. If I take the greater whole of my Cobras and move on their command center's position from the east, they will be forced to come out and face me. Which will leave Colonel Sortek open for a surgical strike from your lance. 

I've provided possible locations for the coalition's HQ to Ryana. Take Sortek out, then fall back. The scenario should end if we are able to take him out and withdraw in one piece. Let the Cobras buy you the time we need to finish this and take these high and mighty nobles down a peg.

misiones.resumen: Take down the Gotterdammerung Society
misiones.briefing:
It's great to meet you, Commander. Thank you for coming. 

Over two hundred years ago during the early Succession Wars, Kirchbach was conquered by the Draconis Combine. Many who feared the Combine's brutal reputation relocated deeper into the Lyran Commonwealth, abandoning homes, properties, and noble titles as they fled. Once conquered, the Draconis Combine forced the migration of millions of Rasalhague families to Kirchbach, leveraging them as cheap labor to clean up the devastation House Kurita left in their wake. 

Now that Kirchbach has been returned to the Tamar Pact, those with ancestral claims to properties that still exist within the system have returned to claim what they feel is rightfully theirs with Duke Kelswa's blessing. This brings them into direct conflict with the Rasalhague families that have owned the same lands for generations under Kuritan rule.

This mess was already FUBAR to begin with, but now Duke Kelswa has thrown inferno gel on the entire situation by enlisting the services of a mercenary group known as the Gotterdammerung Society. Former LCAF thugs and veterans of Operation GOTTERDAMMERUNG that went mercenary to relive the "glory days" of the recent Fourth Succession War. And they do so by enforcing evictions, openly intimidating and, in some cases, physically assaulting the Rasalhague natives in-system. 

All while in plain view of me and my First Tyr, who all have direct ties to the Rasalhague community. My unit and I agree that we can no longer stand on the sideline and let this happen, but our hands are tied due to our allegiance to the Lyran Commonwealth. We cannot openly move against mercenaries hired by our liege lord without risking a firing squad. Which is why I need your help. 

I want you to cripple the Gotterdammerung Society so they can no longer oppress the citizens of Kirchbach. I've recently come into possession of the IFF transponder codes for a local pirate group by the name of the Blankenburg Beaters. I want you to mask your unit with their IFF frequency and cripple the Gotterdammerung in what will outwardly appear to be a pirate attack from known in-system hostiles.

My second in command Tor Miraborg and I will monitor your progress live on comms and direct you as needed. Good hunting, Commander.

misiones.resumen: Destroy the Kelswa Guard's base of operations
misiones.briefing:
Commander, I am Haakon Magnusson, representative of the Rasalhague royal family in exile, and the Tyr independence movement. Christian has transferred the remainder of your existing contract to me. I hope that this will not be an issue for yourself or any of your staff. We all have a lot riding on you.

Christian had the right idea targeting the Gotterdammerung Society, but failed to realize that the true threat is not just the Society, but the one that hired them. One Nicole Kelswa. The niece of the current Duke of Tamar, Selvin Kelswa. She is here on Kirchbach to appease a number of nobles within her uncle's royal court to further cement her uncle's rule over his revitalized Tamar Pact. Which means she cares very little for the well-being of any of the residents of the conquered Kuritan worlds. 

Her reputation inspires fear within the ethnic Rasalhague communities. So I believe the best way to serve the Rasalhague people of Kirchbach is to show them that the Tyr movement is willing to support them and stand up to bullies like her. I want you to attack a facility belonging to the Kelswa Guard, House Kelswa's private honor guard and the Gotterdammerung's primary source of BattleMech support, while under the banner of the Tyr.  

Christian will attempt to run interference to give us a window to execute this mission with minimal resistance from local LCAF forces. Don't let us down, Commander.

misiones.resumen: Garrison the new Capital of the Free Rasalhague Republic
misiones.briefing:
Ok everyone, eyes up! Time is of the essence here. 

At 0400 this morning, the Draconis Combine's Internal Security Force issued orders from DCMS high command to the Eighth Rasalhague Regulars and Sun Zhang Academy Cadre. They were ordered to take custody of Marcus Kurita, cousin of Coordinator Takashi Kurita, and immediately withdraw the entirety of their forces from Rasalhague and report to the Draconis Combine capital of Luthien.

At 0700, KungsArmé military police arrested Marcus Kurita at his planetary estate without incident. Once in custody, the KungsArmé contacted the ISF at the new Combine embassy and arranged for Marcus' extradition through a handoff with an ISF collection team. 

At 0800, en route to the ISF handoff, the convoy carrying Marcus Kurita and the ISF collection team came under attack from hostiles containing both 'Mechs and armor. Freeing Marcus Kurita from our custody. We now know that these hostiles are affiliated with the Eighth Rasalhague Regulars. The ISF collection team put out calls for the Twelfth Sun Zhang to support but were killed before a response could be given. The Combine Embassy has just informed us that they believe the entire Eighth Rasalhague Regulars have gone rogue, refusing all given stand down orders, and have given us permission to mobilize our forces ahead of our scheduled timeline. 

The ISF and I are jointly tracking these two groups of rogue Regulars. They are both converging on one place: The Reykjavik Spaceport. We can only assume that they are attempting to flee the system with Marcus Kurita. 

We cannot allow this to happen. I am ordering the full mobilization of the Frist Tyr and all supporting mercenary forces. Stop Marcus Kurita and the Regulars from leaving Rasalhague at all cost! The safety of our new Republic is at stake! Mount up and move out!

misiones.resumen: Secure the Rasalhague Regulars base of operations
misiones.briefing:
The DropShip carrying Marcus Kurita has left Rasalhague's planetary perimeter and is now en-route to the system's jump point. Attempts to pursue his DropShip were called off when military DropShips and aerospace assets belonging to the Eighth Rasalhague Regulars and Tenth Sun Zhang Training Cadre fell in to screen Kurita's path to Rasalhague's jump point. We simply don't have the naval assets on-hand to contest them in space. We're expecting that a large majority of both rouge DCMS units and Kurita himself will jump out of system within the coming days. 

This is a disaster. I'm already receiving reports of other DCMS units refusing their stand down orders sparking violence on a number of worlds throughout our new Republic. Although ComStar has barred Marcus' wide-band declaration of war from being transmitted through their HPG network, his message has already been recorded and ferried to a number of systems via DropShip relays from Combine sympathizers and merchant guilds.

Things will only get worse the longer Marcus Kurita is in the wind. We need to find out where he is going and take him back into custody. The ISF has forwarded us the location of the Eighth Rasalhague Regular's primary base of operations. They say that if we can take hold of this facility before the remaining Regulars in-system destroy it, they will provide assistance decrypting any secrets left by the Regulars that might point to their destination. 

Christian, Commander, I cannot stress how vital this mission is to the survival of our new Republic. See that this gets done.

misiones.resumen: Establish a beachhead for the First Tyr
misiones.briefing:
With the help of the Draconis Combine's Internal Security Force, we've tracked Marcus Kurita, the Eighth Rasalhague Regulars, and the Tenth Sun Zhang Training Cadre to the agricultural world of Predlitz. This system was gifted to the Free Rasalhague Republic as a major regional breadbasket to feed the Republic. Unfortunately, the populace of Predlitz are fiercely loyal to the Coordinator and the Combine. So when news came that their system would be transferred to our new Republic, the local populace became furious. 

The mix of what they see as a betrayal on the part of the Coordinator, and fierce rejection of Rasalhague independence caused the local populace to storm the local parliamentary building and take the Republic appointed Valdherre and his administration hostage. When Marcus Kurita appeared in-system vowing to destroy the Republic and return all worlds back into the Draconis Combine, the citizens of Predlitz welcomed him with open arms. 

Gunji-no-Kanrei Theodore Kurita for his part has disavowed the actions of all enlisted DCMS members that have refused their orders to withdraw from Republic space. Publically declaring all those rejecting their direct orders ronin. His office has also been in touch with Prince Magnusson pledging the deployment of loyal members of the DCMS to assist the KungsArmé in pacifying any ronin forces operating within the Free Rasalhague Republic's borders.

While all of this is good news, the only way to end this madness is to recapture Marcus Kurita. But with the local populace aiding his ronin forces, it will be an uphill battle to bring him into custody. The task at hand is now to establish a beachhead on Predlitz and ensure that our DropShips can land our forces safely. Commander, I'll be counting on you and your forces to be the vanguard of this assault. Carve us a path.

misiones.resumen: Probe Marcus Kurita's Defenses
misiones.briefing:
The entirety of the First Tyr have touched down in system with minimal damage. Excellent work everyone. 

Commander, this next mission will fall squarely on you and your unit's shoulders. The local populace of Predlitz are fierce supporters of the Combine and Marcus Kurita's cause. Because of this, locals are actively impeding us from locating his base of operations. Which means we need to take things into our own hands to triangulate its location by prodding the ronins' defenses. 

Unfortunately, this is not something that the First Tyr as a unit is set up to do. The First Tyr is the Republic's assault battalion, specializing in direct confrontations and siege breaking, leveraging mostly slower heavy and assault 'Mechs. Skirmishing and prodding defensive lines will do nothing more than make our slow 'Mechs vulnerable to ambushes from fast movers. So for this task, we will need to rely on you and your team's expertise to get this done. 

We're counting on you, Commander.

misiones.resumen: Capture Marcus Kurita
misiones.briefing:
Commander, I've now had a chance to make contact with the incoming DCMS DropShips on a heavy burn towards Predlitz. They belong to the Second Sword of Light. House Kurita's premier BattleMech regiment. Their commander, Tai-Sho Goshi Tengwan, says that he is here on behalf of Gunji-no-Kanrei Theodore Kurita to assist the First Tyr bringing Marcus Kurita to justice. 

Despite the Sword of Light's commitment to support our cause, we cannot afford to wait for them to make planetfall. By now, Marcus Kurita will undoubtable know that the Sword of Light are here to bring him in and will likely make plans to flee the same way he fled Rasalhague. We need to pin Marcus in place while we wait for the Second Sword of Light to arrive and deliver the killing blow. 

I've already ordered the First Tyr to encircle Marcus Kurita's position to prevent his escape. When the Sword of Light break atmosphere, which will be the signal to advance on Marcus Kurita's forces. Commander, I will need your team ready by that time. This will be an all-hands on deck mission. If we can pin the ronin forces down, the Sword of Light will help us finally cut the head off of this snake. Good hunting out there.

misiones.resumen: Destroy the Gotterdammerung Society's munitions factory
misiones.briefing:
I've just been briefed by the Dragon's Breath to the current situation on the ground. The capital of Stortalar City is tightly secured by our old friends, Nicole Kelswa and her mercenaries, the Gotterdammerung Society. She is refusing to recognize the Archon's orders and is holding Gunzburg on behalf of the Tamar Pact and her uncle, Duke Selvin Kelswa. 

Also contesting Gunzburg is a group of ronin invaders calling themselves the 211th Mechanized Assault Command. They are fighting to reclaim Gunzburg in the name of the Draconis Combine, so far they have only been able to secure a number of terraforming equipment plants but they do hold a sizeable presence here.

Out of the two hostiles in-system, Nicole Kelswa and her Gotterdammerung Society are the primary threat. Mostly due to the fact that they have dug themselves into major population centers across the system. If we are to minimize civilian casualties, we will need to draw Kelswa out. And I believe we have just the plan to do that. 

The Dragon's Breath have identified numerous logistical targets that the Lyran forces leverage to supply their forces. A simultaneous strike against these targets should force Kelswa out of her entrenched position to defend her supply chain. Commander, your target will be what we believe is the Gotterdammerung Society's primary munitions depot. See that anything of material value is destroyed then withdraw and regroup with the First Tyr and prepare for Kelswa's counter advance. 
Many of our 'MechWarriors in the First Tyr come from Gunzburg, including Överste-Löjtnant Miraborg. For them, this fight is personal. So let's make this one count.

misiones.resumen: Destroy the Ronin Forces
misiones.briefing:
It's with a heavy heart that I must report that while our strikes against the Lyran's logistical network were successful, we failed to draw Nicole Kelswa or any of her forces away from their strongholds. Instead, Nicole Kelswa chose to retaliate by murdering a number of civilian family members, many from within our ranks.

While my heart bleeds for Överste-Löjtnant Miraborg and all the other members of the Tyr that lost someone to Kelswa's cowardly act, our desire for vengeance cannot cloud our judgement. Kelswa clearly committed this heinous war crime to bait us into attacking her and the Gotterdammerung Society on their terms. Throwing ourselves into a meat grinder to get vengeance on Kelswa will only benefit the ronin forces also laying claim to Gunzburg. So for now, we need to leave Kelswa behind her walls. With her logistical chain now in shambles, attrition will eventually take hold and force her out into the open. 

Instead, we'll refocus our efforts to breaking the ronin 211th Mechanized Assault Command. Their forces are scattered across a wide area using sympathetic villages and remote industrial hubs to house their forces that they are unable to fortify. Provided we sweep wide to engage their entire force before they can consolidate, we should be able to envelop them quickly and efficiently so we can then turn our attention to bringing Kelswa and her mercenaries to justice. 

For this operation we'll be dividing our forces and engaging the ronin along two major fronts.  Överste-Löjtnant Miraborg and the Dragon's Breath will take the northern theater while the Commander and I will take the south. I know that it's going to be hard after all that's happened, but stay focused, stay safe, and I promise you, Keslwa will be next!

misiones.resumen: Destroy the remaining ronin and Gotterdammerung Society forces
misiones.briefing:
Following the Dragon's Breath's desertion and Överste-Löjtnant Miraborg's last stand, both the Gotterdammerung Society and the ronin 211th Mechanized Assault Command have diverted their attention towards each other, no longer perceiving the First Tyr as the primary threat in the fight over Gunzburg. While this has provided us with a limited window to lick our wounds and recover, I'm afraid that window is now closing fast.

I've just received word that the Gotterdammerung Society landed a huge blow against the ronin of the 211th Mechanized Assault Command. The ronin have been pushed out of the territory they once occupied, and have fallen back to the Bavaria Mountains. Kelswa is now mobilizing the entirety of the Gotterdammerung and the Kelswa Guards to move on the ronin's position and destroy them for good. After they destroy the ronin, Kelswa will likely turn to hunt us down next. In our present state, that would be a fight we cannot win.

Our best chance of taking Kelswa out is to overwhelm her when she least expects it. Which will be in the midst of her operation against the ronin. With our blow to her logistics network, the Lyran 'Mechs and vehicles can only run on the ammo they can physically carry into a fight. If we catch Keslwa and her mercs at the right time, we could use the ronin as a force multiplier pushing the Gotterdammerung to bleed their limited ammo bins dry. This will give us our best chance at drawing Keslwa out and killing her which should send her mercs packing.   

I won't lie, this op will be an extreme Hail Mary. While millions of things can go sideways, the reality is that this is our last chance at giving the people of Gunzburg their freedom. We owe it to Miraborg, our murdered families, and those countless others who've already laid down their lives in the name of freedom to continue this fight! And God willing, we will emerge victorious!

misiones.resumen: Establish a beachhead for the First Tyr
misiones.briefing:
Under Kuritan rule, Radstadt housed one of the Draconis Combine's largest prison facilities, meant to hold House Kurita's most prized political prisoners and POWs, which they heavily guarded with a network of military bases and supply outposts. When the First Tyr took Radstadt in the name of House Steiner during the Fourth Succession War, the Ninth Pesht Regulars destroyed records of their hidden military supply caches in the hopes of one day reclaiming the system. 

Since the Ronin War began, a number of raids have happened on Radstadt, with ronin raiders attempting to secure these hidden supplies. The First Kavalleri have been in system defending warehouses from raiding ronin with the help of the Vinson's Vigilantes mercenary unit. But according to the Kavalleri, the Vigilantes have lately become less then helpful. 

The mercenaries were given a garrison assignment at a Wakazashi electronics complex. When a recent ronin raid attempted to seize the capital, the Vigilantes refused to assist, stating that their contract stipulates that they are solely there to garrison the Wakazashi complex. While the Kavelleri successfully defended the capital, they took heavy losses in the process which has led to them being unable to contest Alexander's ronin when they arrived.

In order to link up with the Kavalleri, we'll need to break through Alexander's forces. They have moved 'Mech and artillery assets to defensive overwatch positions on our optimal LZs. Commander, I'll need your unit to secure a beachhead for the First Tyr so we can make planetfall safely. After our losses on Gunzburg we can ill afford any further unnecessary casualties. Good hunting.

misiones.resumen: Capture Alexander Kurita
misiones.briefing:
Good work Commander. 

Thanks to you we've made planetfall with zero casualties and have successfully linked up with the First Kavalleri. 

The Kavalleri have been shadowing Alexander Kurita's forces since they touched down in-system a month ago. They report that Alexander's ronin have discovered a Kuritan weapons cache that was hidden during the Fourth Succession War. The ronin have spent the past month getting the base operational once more and are in the process of excavating numerous 'Mechs and munitions still locked in underground facilities around the complex. 

We need to move on them now, before they can further excavate more 'Mechs and munitions. Alexander Kurita remains the primary target for this operation. Neutralize him and his supporting forces and we can destroy the final vestige of hope the ronin have that they will rally to continue their crusade. 

But tread carefully. The Kavalleri report that Alex pilots a 'Mech that they have never seen before. Their field reports state that it appears to be a heavily modified Charger, wielding a 'Mech sized sword and using armor fashioned to look like samurai armor. A walking symbol of the ronin's bigoted ideals. Be sure not to underestimate him or his men. For them and all the other ronin holdouts, this will be their last stand.

This is our best opportunity to end this war once and for all Commander. Stay sharp and good hunting.

misiones.resumen: Drive out Davion forces and retake The Ninth Sun Zhang Academy Cadre base.
misiones.briefing:
Commander,

I am Tai-Shu Michi Noketsuna, warlord of the Dieron Military District. I am pleased Mori has contracted you to aid us in the cause. I know in doing so you face great risk courtesy of the short-sighted edict handed down by The Coordinator.

Thanks to the tremendous foresight of Gunji-no-Kanrei Theodore Kurita, his calculated move to allow Rasalhague its independence created a buffer state that would deny a full-scale invasion by The Lyran Commonwealth. But in doing so, great pressure has been placed upon Dieron as it borders both halves of The FedCom Alliance.

There is no time to mince words: Davion will bring down the hammer upon Dieron. This is ground-zero for the oncoming storm with two-star nations set to pour through our borders.

We must halt The Davion thrust as much as we can. If we can buy time there is a plan in place to push them into a war of attrition that could give us a ray of hope.

I am folding you into The Fifth Amphigean Light Assault Unit along with their General Kent Gerber, the Combine’s very own mercenary security group exempt from The Death to Mercenaries Edict.

Gerber is aware of the arrangement, pleased to have the extra manpower at his disposal. This is a trial run to see how well you fit in with this group.

There is no time to spare. Davion forces have already hit our shores. We need to get you into a 'Mech and onto the battlefield immediately.

misiones.resumen: Hold off the invading Davion forces for as long as possible.
misiones.briefing:
I ain't gonna blow smoke, Commander you’re in the fryin’ pan now.

The Commonwealth is comin’ back to finish the job they started during the The Fourth Succession War. Units are comin’ to plow right through us and spread through the Combine like a flesh-eatin’ disease.

The powers that be got no problem throwin’ The Fifth into the meat grinder. They finally threw us a bone and gave us some teeth in the fight, but it ain't gonna bring back the men I’ve buried. You choose a life of war, collectin’ scars is part of the game. But I’m tired of carvin’ names into headstones. You could fill a graveyard with the men that have bought it under my command.

I keep hearin’ tales from men livin’ in ivory towers about reforms that will protect the boots on the ground, but until I see them bolted into solid reality I ain't gonna hold my breath.

Damn glad to have you to inject some muscle into our ranks, Commander, but don’t get stuck in the mud. The Combine’s company store scheme has boxed-in Merc units like yours many times. Before you realize you’ve stepped on the landmine you’ve already been blown into a million pieces.

But we’ll need to put that on the back burner. Right now, we got a whole lot of fight comin’ our way. Prep up, you’re gonna be run through a gauntlet.

We’re not gonna make life easy for them. Sho-Sho Nordica’s supportin’ us with Fourteenth Legion units; they made their name killin’ Lyran Guards during The Fourth Succession War, so you’re in good company. You’ll also have artillery batteries set around the battle zone to help keep 'em off your back.

Hold off the invaders as long as you can, Commander. Don’t give 'em an inch. Sho-Sho Nordica and I will call the game.

Give 'em hell!

misiones.resumen: Advance into the city and recover encrypted files belonging to Don' Carlos.
misiones.briefing:
Listen up Commander, a new sit-rep just hit my desk and it’s a whopper.

Unlike the Combine, FedCom ain't shy about hirin’ some heavy-hittin’ merc units to do their dirty work. They’ve contracted Camacho’s Caballeros, the Seventeenth Recon Regiment and Colonel Merwin’s First Grave Walkers. They’re callin’ themselves Taskforce Blizzard.

Bastards hit the spaceport in Nasew, knifin’ through light armor security units like butter. If that aint’ bad enough, word is Rhonda Snord and her Irregulars are standin’ by in the area just waitin’ for the green light.

Don Carlos and his boys have made themselves right at home; they’ve set up shop inside the heart of the city. We’re gonna give The Caballero’s and The Grave Walkers a one-way ticket to the scrapyard, but we got work to do.

Advanced recon scan probed the area showin’ Don Carlos’s gear is stashed inside the city. Haul ass into the target area and scoop up The Caballero’s encrypted files. We get our hands on those, we can crack 'em open and gain the upper-hand.

Don Carlos won’t just hand over the goods Commander, so get in and out without gettin’ your wings clipped.

Move out.

misiones.resumen: Identify and destroy targets belonging to The 17th Recon Regiment.
misiones.briefing:
That was solid work nabbing that intel right under the 17th Recon's nose, Commander. The encrypted files have thrown The Caballero’s arsenal right out into the open. It’s on you and The Fifth to head into the objective area and paint the targets. Leave nothin’ but fire and smoke.

Carlos has a flair for the dramatic. He won’t sit on the sidelines for long. If he sticks his nose out, knock his ass out of the game.

Happy huntin’, Commander.

misiones.resumen: Destroy the vacant Legion bases before Snord's Irregulars can capture them.
misiones.briefing:
Don Carlos and The Caballero’s have bowed out, but we’re not out of the woods by a longshot, Commander. Snord’s Irregulars have been given the greenlight to join the fray.

Rhonda is a chip off the old block of her old man, Cranston Snord. She hasn’t been in the driver’s seat long, but she’s lookin’ to make her mark now that she’s got the wheel. Snord’s Irregulars broke off from Wolf’s Dragoons back in the day so you know they’re tough as nails.

The Irregulars have been spotted inside Orlux. Sho-Sho Nordica cleared out a pair of Fourteenth Legion bases, but now The Commonwealth wants to take 'em to really dig in their heels here

This is a scorched earth op. We can’t let The Irregulars get their hands on 'em. Last thing we wanna do is destroy our own assets, but we’re backed into a corner here. I’ve split you into two attack groups; while you take out a vacant Legion Base on one point of the map, Chu-Sa Olesko will lead his own unit and level the second Legion base on another front.

Get the job done out there, Commander. Snord’s Irregulars have made a name collectin’ things; our bases won’t be added to that list.

misiones.resumen: Hit the field and facilitate a Medivac for Chu-Sa Olesko.
misiones.briefing:
Commander, a priority alert just came in.

Chu-Sa Olesko’s unit has been ambushed by Snord’s Irregulars in the Bandii Wastes, Northeast of New Egypt. His Lancemates are reportin’ Olesko's down and unresponsive. The Fifth never leaves a man behind. We ain't gonna start now. We need to get Olesko strapped to a medivac VTOL and dust him out. Get in the fight, otherwise the Chu-Sa’s a goner.

Move fast Commander, Olesko’s countin’ on you.

misiones.resumen: Form a defensive shield around the three Union DropShips to ensure Gerber and his men burn out safely.
misiones.briefing:
I got good news and bad news, Commander. Early signs point to Chu-Sa Olesko makin’ a full recovery. He won’t be in the seat of a ‘Mech anytime soon but you really saved his ass out there. The bad news is my men are droppin’ like flies. I’m not offerin’ up more of my boys to slaughter.

I’m pullin’ my men out of here while we still have a pulse. Sho-Sho Nordica will remain here in Vega with The Fourteenth, but we need to burn out and regroup. That’s the only way we’re gonna keep combat power and be of any use to the fight movin’ forward. The Alliance and Snord’s Irregulars smell blood in the water. They’re gonna throw everythin’ at us to try and knock us out of the game for good.

I need you to help us punch our ticket outta here. Our men have been loaded up into three Union DropShips that will get us out of dodge. It’s on you to shield three Union DropShips and ensure they launch out. You won’t be in this alone, Sho-Sho has set a full complement of Fourteenth Legion units to fight alongside you.

It’s a big ask, Commander, but I got faith you will get the job done. Sho-Sho Nordica and I will update the status of the launches as they unfold.

Leave it all out there, Commander! The fate of me and my men is in your hands!

misiones.resumen: Collect the data fragments along the objective route in order to piece together actionable intel.
misiones.briefing:
As-salamu alaykum, Commander.

I am Li Cheng, Brigadier General of The Fourth Arkab Legion. Ta-Shu Michi gave you a glowing review regarding your performance during your assignment on Vega. We don’t usually accept help from other units, but these are trying times.

The counter-invasion enacted by Theodore Kurita is now underway. Although my people don’t always see eye to eye with House Kurita, a bold move is needed to try and turn the tide of this war. Without it, our people and very way of life will be eradicated from existence.

We’re being inundated with transmissions from within our homeland. Loki agents are running amok, forcing our citizens to declare the FedCom alliance as liberators and forcing them into stating lies that The Combine government is starving them and wresting children from their homes at birth to be indoctrinated into our military ranks

This is causing discord amongst my officers; many believe that this counter-invasion is just a fool’s errand on the part of Theodore Kurita. There is a palpable feeling of doubt that plunging deep into the regions of The Federated Suns and Lyran Commonwealth is doing anything but abandoning our families to death and subjugation.

It is imperative we make our work here count. We’re here to make enough noise that the Alliance pulls their front-line units back and send them after us.

The Auldhouse Militia are Steiner Loyalists who won’t think twice about offering their lives for the cause. Dusting these skeleton units isn’t our objective here. The Saurimat agent visually confirmed a series of data fragments contained inside vertical servers on marked points inside the city of Arkendorf; we must acquire the data fragments.

Sounds simple enough, but each fragment is carved with its own encrypted code. The intel on each fragment alone is useless unless they’re bonded together to form a larger whole. Move with haste, Commander. Without actionable intel we will remain in a static hold and any momentum we may gain will die on the vine.

My second in command, Tai-Sa Omari Ali and I will monitor the proceedings on comms. Strike fast as lightning, Commander.

misiones.resumen: Sever the LCAF supply chains by levelling the marked food distribution hub and armory.
misiones.briefing:
Excellent work, Commander. I see the assessment of your performance was spot on. It took some doing, but we connected the data shards and deciphered the data. Sadly, the shards had a self-destruct trigger; one of our DropShips suffered heavy damage and we lost one intelligence officer.

Unfortunately, that death will be for not if we can't exploit the gathered information.

The neighboring city of Shivren contains high payoff targets belonging to the LCAF; a weapons armory and a food distribution hub. Both are integral supply chains for LCAF forces. If we succeed in forcing them to reinforce this area, they will find their supply chains broken.

At worst, the local populace will be unarmed and hungry. A heavy dose of their own medicine after what our people have endured during the invasion. Hit the armory and food hub on the marked points, Commander. Show you can keep pace with The Fourth Arkab.

Good luck.

misiones.resumen: Destroy anti-air emplacements along target route in order for the Fourth Arkab to set down in Arcturus.
misiones.briefing:
Commander – this operation falls squarely on your shoulders. You have already proven you can keep up with the Fourth Arkab, now you need to hit the ground running and clear a safe landing zone for our DropShips. This will be no easy feat. Remnants of The Arcturan Guards that remain in system have fortified the city with anti-air cannons emplaced around the target route. In addition, pockets of Arcturan militia are formed up to defend their home at all costs. You must prosecute each one of them.

The Alliance will be unable to ignore our presence in the former capital. Our officers are raring to go. Any lingering doubts about the purpose of this counter-invasion have been erased after receiving word that Theodore Kurita has led the charge with the Ryuken, piloting a ‘Mech himself.

Despite Davion’s propaganda saying otherwise, The Ryuken has pierced into The Commonwealth and successfully landed in Breed. We must continue to do our part.

Clear the air avenue of approach, Commander. We’re counting on you.

misiones.resumen: Advance into the city and eliminate the marked Acturan media center and Government structure.
misiones.briefing:
You continue to impress, Commander. Now that we have set in Arcturus it is time we bring the curtains down on their citizens here in the capital city of Malcheema. Saurimat and ISF secured vital intel from Arcturan media members who oppose The FedCom invasion and have dared to file reports shedding light on Hanse Davion’s actions in triggering this war.

Davion is sly; he knows that if his incitement was based on his own personal gains, he will not be looked upon favorably. He may already feel his sphere of influence shrinking by the second

The 24th Arcturan guards that remain in the system have been able to settle the waters and quiet the growing dissent amongst their own people. They have begun broadcasting propaganda pieces to gloss over any contrary statements about the invasion of The Combine.

Malcheema’s militia units have been particularly brutal. They have been detonating houses of known sympathizers to strike fear in others that may possess misgivings of their own. In addition, Malcheema’s planetary governors are said to be convening in their statehouse to discuss how to deal with our counter-strikes.

This presents a great opportunity to topple their government apparatus and media center in one fell swoop. Not only will we control the message, but the deafening silence will tell FedCom that they’re losing Arcturus and Davion will be forced to act.

I know what you may be thinking, Commander. Hitting government and civilian centers like this is a direct violation of the Ares Convention, but Davion set the terms. They have had no qualms about firing upon our citizens and forcing them to submit to their rule, or die. Desperate times call for desperate measures and the future of our people and homeland is at stake here.

Level the marked targets, Commander. Let us send a wave of panic back to the highest reaches of The FedCom ranks.

misiones.resumen: Advance to the marked Arcturan Arms complex and eliminate all of the Arcturan guard forces.
misiones.briefing:
Panic is spreading like wildfire across the Commonwealth, Commander. Concrete intel has been hard to come by recently.

There are also conflicting reports that Hanse Davion is swallowing the bait, in a state of disbelief that we have the numbers to launch such an effective counter-invasion. Word is he is already gathering forces to dispatch back home, but we cannot be sure. We must carry on our work here.

We have dealt a blow to their government and media apparatus, but now we must hit them where it hurts: The Arcturan Arms complex.

It may not be what it once was, but The LCAF still uses it to refurbish their battered ‘Mechs. Losing it will be costly for their reinforcement capabilities moving forward.

You and The Fourth must pierce through The Arcturan Guards along the target path. Once you have reached the Arcturan Arms complex, you must destroy each complex wing.

Sever the Arcturan Arms from The LCAF, Commander. When they do return home they will find one of their most prominent facilities reduced to ash

Beware of the ‘Mech units currently being repaired, they will be looking to survive at all costs.

misiones.resumen: Move into the city and eliminate the marked targets and clear the area of any hostiles.
misiones.briefing:
There is light at the end of the tunnel, Commander. The fall of The Arcturan Arms complex has sent shockwaves through The Commonwealth. Backchannel whispers have the commonwealth high command discussing sending forces back to defend their embattled worlds.

But we still have work ahead of us. Strategic military targets remain here in Arcturus, namely an LCAF airfield and communications tower; we must bring them both down.

It will not be easy. Swarms of Arcturan Guards and militia units have come out of hiding and looking to defend these at all costs. Omari has already dispatched Fourth Arkab units into the target area.

Drop down and surge through, Commander. While the Fourth are engaged in battle bring those targets down.

Good luck.

misiones.resumen: Move into the city and destroy the target buildings and root out the Alliance forces entrenched in the area.
misiones.briefing:
This is it, Commander. We have finally returned to our own soil. It is time to exact vengeance and root out these FedCom invaders. We no longer have to temper our anger and frustration just unleash it.

If The FedCom Alliance believed this system would remain undefended they’re in for a serious shock to the system.

Saurimat and ISF have located the temporary office of a corrupt FedCom Magistrate that has spent his tenure here wreaking havoc and discord amongst the populace. They have set up disinformation outposts, brainwashing our citizens into believing that they are their liberators, not their conquerors.

It ends now! Destroy the target buildings and we will begin to unshackle the citizens of Trolloc Prime and hopefully the rest of The Combine.

Help silence that lie-spewing coward, Commander!

misiones.resumen: Kill The Knights of St. Cameron forces that remain garrisoned in Rakken.
misiones.briefing:
Rooting out that vile coward was a great start. But this is only the beginning, Commander. We already have reports streaming in that Hanse Davion has sent a recall order. Many FedCom DropShips have been seen fleeing the system.

But our work is not done. Before he fell, the Magistrate was able to hail Allistair, the leader of The Knights of St. Cameron mercenary unit. They have been in system, employed by the FedCom Alliance and doing their bidding.

I will slice straight to the bone: they must all be destroyed. Area scans have located them in the fields of Rakken. You and The Fourth will meet them – and give them all a dirt nap.

End The Knights of St. Cameron’s occupation here, Commander. For The Combine!

misiones.resumen: Pierce through The Shredders' defensive fortifications and link up with Hansen's Roughriders.
misiones.briefing:
Welcome to Galatea City, Commander Mason. Your timely response to the call is much appreciated, as we currently face a pressing issue that demands immediate attention. Ronan’s Shredders, a formidable group of pirates, has wreaked havoc upon Galatea City, armed with substantial firepower. While their motivations remain unclear, I suspect they may be acting as a trojan horse sent by The Dragoons on Outreach to sow chaos and discord.

The Shredders initiated shadow raids, targeting key locations such as Galaport and Cone City before focusing on the Mercenary Review  Board Center within Galatea City. The potential threat lies in their interest in raiding data caches, which contain sensitive personal information, banking details, and other valuable data belonging to mercenary units that they could exploit or sell on the open market.

Hansen’s Roughriders, serving as a roaming security force in the system, attempted to confront Ronan’s Shredders but found themselves outmatched. The Shredders have strategically pinned them behind defensive fortifications on the path to the MRBC. To prevent further damage to Galatea's reputation and economy, your mission is crucial: break through Ronan’s defensive forces, unite with Hansen’s Roughriders, and thwart the pirates' attempt to pillage The MRBC.

Given the gravity of the situation, we cannot afford any missteps. Your decisive actions are essential to restoring order and preventing additional harm to Galatea. Outreach has already inflicted enough damage, and your success in this mission is pivotal in safeguarding our system and its economic prospects moving forward. We do not want ComStar to believe we can't maintain the MRB.

misiones.resumen: Drive these filthy pirates out!
misiones.briefing:
You've certainly hit the ground running, Commander; this is an effective start. You've broken through the Shredders lines and loosened their grip on the Roughriders, but they still have control of the MRBC. I fear that even if they're not able to secure the mercenary units' personal data caches, they may just go scorched earth. You and the Roughriders must prevent this at all costs!

Galatea cannot afford for ComStar to get wind of this situation and lose faith in our ability to take care of business. I will not stand by and allow Outreach to strip away our identity. Some are already referring to The Dragoon’s outpost as the new Mercenary Star. I need you and the Roughriders to send the message loud and clear: Galatea is not ripe for the taking, nor will it become an afterthought for Mercenaries seeking to ply their trade across the Inner Sphere.

misiones.resumen: Help Duncan Fisher through the gauntlet match.
misiones.briefing:
Alright, buddy, listen up. The gauntlet match is about to kick off, and I need you to keep your cool! You got this! Don't doubt yourself or your abilities for a second! If we fail to win this tournament, we'll be denying Solaris the chance to witness the rise of the next great MechWarrior!...Me! You know the fans are itching to live on the edge of their seats and chant Duncan Fisher's name! We gotta give 'em what they want! 

Who knows, maybe these teams will just fold at the mere sight of me, ready to lay down and let me sprint back to Solaris. But in case they don't, and they actually put up a fight, get ready to bring the heat! I'll be right there with you, soaking up every moment. I mean, sure, I'll fire a few laser blasts too, but now that I see you up close, I kinda get the feeling you won't need much help. So fire away when we hit the arena! I won't feel like you're hogging all the action!

My trusty 'Mech's showing its age, not likely to catch its second wind anytime soon. Took a nasty hit last go-round, glitched out on me like a stubborn mule. But hey, optimism's the name of the game, right? And with you around to lend a hand, I reckon we'll manage just fine. Let's chalk up that mishap to the "things I'd rather not repeat" column. In my book, ignoring troubles often makes 'em vanish quicker than a pilots clothes after an ammo blast!  

Okay, enough talk! Strap in and let’s do this!

misiones.resumen: Help Duncan battle his way through the grand finale.
misiones.briefing:
Oh baby! Those chumps bit the dust! You're worth every c-bill, buddy. Some impressive teams are now residents in the losers circle thanks to us. Putting on a show for Ava Masters is just icing on the cake!

But Ava's ‘gonna have to wait 'cause Solaris is calling me back, and my heart belongs to those famed arenas. And the Valhalla club! My time on Solaris got cut short before I could become the star I know i am. But eventually fate stops being a jerk and will let nature takes its course!

I'm scripting a tale that ends on Solaris and nothing is 'gonna stand in my way. Well, except for these final teams in this free-for-all match. Honestly, they should just throw in the towel now and save us all some time. But nope, they're gonna drag us through the motions. So, let's not play with our food and vaporize these pretenders! Then punch our golden ticket to Solaris! The Duncan Fisher comeback tour is on!

misiones.resumen: Rendezvous with Duncan's contact from Solaris Arm
misiones.briefing:
It’s good to be back!  We’re in the shit now. Apologies for the crappy meeting spot; my friend is a bit on the paranoid side. Now, for a bit of history – these swamplands used to host a massive sewage treatment plant during the Star League era, giving the whole place that distinct aroma of... well, you get the idea. But no time to stop and sniff those stinky roses!

This location may not scream luxury, but it's perfect for covert meetings and clandestine dealings. Now, onto the juicy stuff – my contact, a real mover and shaker over at Solaris Arms, has been dishing out the deets on cutting-edge 'mech R&D. And between you and me, they're at the forefront of 'Mech ass-kickery.

Here's the deal: if I'm gonna make a splash in Solaris, I can't rely on my old bucket of bolts. Nope, I need the latest and greatest and Solaris Arms has the big guns.

So, let's get those engines humming, hit the road, and kick this into high gear. We've got a few drinks waiting for us before the tournament kicks off, and you know I can't pass up a good celebration. Or any reason to knock one back for that matter!  Onward to glory! I've got history to make and fans to entertain!

misiones.resumen: Duke it out in the opening phase of The FedCom Unification Tournament
misiones.briefing:
Commander,

My probe into the underbelly of Solaris City has been riddled with difficulty. The shadows harbor unforeseen dangers at every turn. Mafia and Yakuza agents lurk everywhere. The last thing we need is one of these groups catching wind of your presence and becoming involved. Thankfully, I've built a career on dodging trouble and keeping things under control. No small feat in this cesspool. If I fail, the party that hired me to help foil this plot will ensure my days are numbered. That level of heat will be too much, even for me. So, for both our sakes, maintain your reputation.

The latest intelligence reveals that The Inglorious Outkasts are plotting to unleash their Assassin during the grand finale, precisely when the Solaris council will be gathered in a viewing box within Steiner Stadium. Cunningly, they've infiltrated the arena's ranks with covert agents poised to compromise the protective ballistic shield protecting the spectators - and the Solaris council. Once this shield is compromised, the Assassin will have a clear shot at their target.

It's imperative that you overcome these obstacles, emerge victorious, and thwart the Outkasts' plan. If one of the teams takes you down, nothing will stand in the way of The Outkasts' plan. The fate of Solaris and the lives of the Council hang in the balance. The pressure is on, Commander, but you're no stranger to adversity. Keep living up to your reputation and get the job done.

misiones.resumen: Confront The Outkasts' Assassin.
misiones.briefing:
Outstanding work, Commander. Your performance inside Steiner Stadium is creating quite the stir, solidifying your name here on Solaris. If you get the job done, you might want to consider a career on the arena circuit. You could make a killing. But first things first...

The coordinated efforts of those rival teams attempting to bring you down were no coincidence. The Outkasts are clearly aware of your presence, which made your ability to rise to the challenge even more impressive. I'm not sure how your involvement was leaked, but that's another problem for another time. I told you, Solaris is a cesspool. Trusting anyone to keep a secret is a life-threatening endeavor on Solaris.

I'm afraid the most lethal part of this task still remains, Mason. The Outkasts' agents still maintain control within the arena. Their plan to sabotage the protective ballistic glass shielding the Solaris Council and the crowd is still in play. The situation is a powder keg waiting to ignite.

Considering The Outkasts' successful infiltration, it's only a matter of time before they unleash their heavy-hitter, but they will bide their time until the council is at its most vulnerable. I'll be keeping a watchful eye on the unfolding events and will alert you the moment the protective shield comes down. It's imperative that you utilize the repair bays as needed. Failure to do so will result in their assassin tearing through everything in its path and plunging Solaris into chaos.

Stay in the fight, Commander, and be ready for my signal. Hold your ground amidst the chaos. The future of the Solaris Council rests in your hands!

misiones.resumen: Intercept the Pirate Forces
misiones.briefing:
Commander Mason – good to have you and your Cavaliers with us on this job. 

I know Månsdottir gave you the rundown on Redjack Ryan and Hendrick Grimm III… What a DropShip fire of a situation. 

I guess we’re the mop-up crew. Seems like pirate raids have been few and far between in recent years, especially since the FRR’s forces have gotten healthy enough after the Ronin Wars to station whole battalions of Battle ‘Mechs along the borders… The pirate filth from The Oberon Confederation and The Greater Valkyrate haven’t had the guts to pick any fights - until now.

We’ve got word that two separate forces are heading right for Alleghe. Now, the system lacks the gear to identify the forces or communicate with them at the system Jump Points. FRR techs have been able to hack into pirate channels, and they cut into a secure broadcast between Redjack and Caleb, one of his many illegitimate kids, off doing his bidding. Caleb’s orders are to raid Alleghe for any vital materiels and get out of dodge.

They’ve been monitoring the Jump Point ever since, and that’s when they visually confirmed more signatures maneuvering in their own formation. I can only speculate, but a solid bet is Grimm’s been keeping tabs on Ryan’s movements, and they’re looking to beat them to the punch, or beat them into the ground. Either way, it spells trouble.

The Alleghe militia is also onboard to give us a hand. An evacuation order was issued for the Stensele’s AG Center and the nearby farmlands with a heavy civilian population, where pirate signatures are present. I ordered their Commanders to head out first and make sure that there’s no stragglers that the pirates can pick off, or trample on.

I also sent a group of mine along with another Alleghe militia regiment to the Old Bolby Spaceport to deal with the pirates that showed up in that area and keep their greasy hands off it. 
It’s up to us to hit the ground and intercept these pirates before they run amok. 

Let’s go hunting!

misiones.resumen: Battle your way to Spears' location
misiones.briefing:
Extracting Spears from a hot zone is putting it mildly, Commander.

My scanners are crawling with Clan activity—like someone kicked over a hornet’s nest and gave them our scent. I’m still waiting on the exact coordinates for his position, but wherever he is, he’s holed up deep in enemy-infested territory.

And the terrain? It’s a nightmare. That route is a maze of jagged canyons, narrow crevices, and towering rock spires—perfect cover for ambushes and long-range fire. Exactly the kind of battlefield they thrive in.

Tread carefully. They’ll have every advantage out there… until you take it from them. I’ll update you the moment Spears’ position pings.

Good hunting, Commander

misiones.resumen: Advance to the city
misiones.briefing:
Welcome to Rodigo, Commander.

Under normal circumstances, I would greet incoming mercenary outfits with a very rude welcome. I won’t sugarcoat it; I have no affinity for your kind. The heinous acts committed by your money soldiers during the Ronin War are forever seared into my memory. 

But these are not ordinary times.

Before your arrival, splinter units of Skinner’s Scimitars and The Black Outlaws retreated here, armed with little more than wild tales about powerful metal aliens that have appeared out of nowhere, spreading like wildfire and consuming everything in their path. 

Before I could even begin to question these accounts, we detected unmarked inbound DropShips. The next thing I knew, I was listening to a transmission from a warrior claiming to be from Clan Wolf, declaring their intent to take possession of the system.

He issued a challenge—something he called a batchall—and demanded to know which forces we would send out to defend the city of New Starburg. I refused to reveal who would be defending the system, just as I will refuse to surrender Rodigo to these wolves. We must band together to repel these forces. 

It starts at New Starburg. We will defend this city and prevent them from planting their flag here at all costs!
