misiones.resumen: Run down the Clan Wolf forces
misiones.briefing:
Commander,

We bloodied the nose of these Wolves, but it is not good enough. Our scans show that these Clanners are not just falling back; we have dealt them such a massive blow that they are retreating. So much for their technological advantage!  

We need to run them down until we’ve wiped them all out and left them with nothing but wreckage and regret!

Gear up! We need to hit the ground and wrangle them up before they can escape. 

They wanted Rodigo - now we’re going to bury them here!

misiones.resumen: Clear the path to the spaceport
misiones.briefing:
Jake, 

I’ve got bad news. With the fighting raging across the system, I’ve lost all contact with my Interstellar Expeditions contacts. Clan forces are deploying heavy electronic countermeasures—comms are jammed, and coordination is next to impossible.

That means pulling your data cache from HQ is a dead end. But not all is lost.

I had a feeling the intel was too dangerous to keep in one place, so I split it up and distributed the fragments to several trusted organizations across Rasalhague—each with their own piece to analyze and safeguard.

We’ll need to recover them all. But that’ll have to wait—because something bigger just came through, and it did make it past the interference.

Prince Magnusson is preparing to evacuate the system, along with a contingent of FRR dignitaries.

Their only route out is through the local spaceport… which Clan Wolf has seized. They’ve locked down every approach with fortified positions and heavy patrols.

Your job is to clear a path—secure the route so the Prince and his people can make it to the spaceport and lift off safely.

Christian Mansdottir is in the area, leading local forces doing everything they can to hold the Wolves back from civilian zones. He’s boosting his signal and will make contact once you’re on the ground. He says he’ll send whatever support he can spare—but they’re stretched thin.

This extraction is critical, Commander. Get Magnusson off-world. Whatever it takes.

misiones.resumen: Advance to the Toro Comms facility
misiones.briefing:
Let’s start with dessert: I’ve pinpointed the location of one of the data packets. It’s on Pinnacle, housed at a Toro Communications satellite station. 

They’re specialists in pattern recognition and buried-data analysis—if something was hidden, they would’ve mined that gold. Odds are the packet’s tucked away in their archived logs.

Now for the vegetables.

We can’t remotely pull the data—it has to be recovered on-site. And Ryana just reported a high concentration of hostile ’Mechs in the area.

There is a militia force on the ground—the Pinnacle Guardsmen—but they're not elite MechWarriors.
They will need your help in holding off whatever forces are being sent to take the facility.  

If the Clanners overrun the site, we lose the packet… maybe for good.

Move in, secure the facility, and make sure that data stays out of enemy hands. I need every last piece to put this puzzle back together.

misiones.resumen: Advance to a target structure
misiones.briefing:
Alright, we’ve got a bit of a unique situation on our hands.

The outfit I sent this data pack to—Sandvik, on Caldrith—has a number of research facilities scattered across the surface. I figured the harsh weather and remote location would give them the privacy they needed to study military tech and refine machine performance in extreme cold.

But instead of storing the data in one secure location, they opted to be clever about it. 

They broke the packet into shards and embedded them into hardened circuit arrays in separate facilities. 

These circuits are rigged to only melt or realign under violent structural collapse. In short, the intel doesn’t trigger unless the building goes down—hard.

Critical telemetry bursts only activate under thermal or kinetic thresholds.

In other words? You level these structures, and each one fires off its shard. I’ve got the systems in place to intercept and reconstruct the full data packet—but only if all the shards are triggered.

It’s more work for you, sure, but it’s a brilliant way to keep sensitive intel out of the wrong hands. Civilians have already been cleared from the sites—but only because the enemy’s taken over. 

And judging from what we’ve seen, they won’t take kindly to you bombing out what they now consider their property.

You’ll need to move fast in the cold, hit every site, and bring down each structure. Only full structural failure will activate the burst. And just one or two shards won’t cut it—I need them all to reconstruct the entire data packet.

Stay warm—and stay alive out there, Commander.

misiones.resumen: Hold off all Smoke Jaguar forces
misiones.briefing:
Commander,

I was beginning to worry the data packet I sent to Lockheed Corporation’s facility in the Vermillion Cliffs on Almunge was lost to the ether. Lockheed runs weapons manufacturing and testing ops out there, but they weren’t responding to any of my low-profile attempts to make contact. Turns out we’ve got the Clans to thank for that.

The First Jaguar Guards have hit Almunge. I managed to get through to Chu-Sa Manderly of the Almunge Infantry Battalion. Most of their forces are tied up clashing with the Jaguars out on the Sculyan Hills.

That said, I convinced Manderly to help us extract the packet from the Vermillion site. It’s stashed in a cliffside safe, buried deep. In exchange, we’ve promised him any intel recovered that might benefit the DCMS. Problem is, with the bulk of their numbers committed elsewhere, the job of holding off the Smoke Jaguar forces at the cliffs falls to you.

Once you engage, Manderly’s team will move to breach the safe and retrieve the packet—but only if you can keep the pressure off them long enough to get the job done.

And Commander, based on the reports we’ve seen from recent Jaguar encounters… this won’t be easy. They’re not just dug in—they’re hunting.

Ready yourselves. You’re heading into one hell of a fight out there in those cliffs.

misiones.resumen: Advance to the manufacturing depot
misiones.briefing:
Hey Commander,

I’ve been tracking a data packet I sent to a company deep in DCMS territory. After talking with my contacts in Kabah, I was convinced the Komatsu manufacturing depot had been wiped off the map—meaning we were out of luck.

Turns out, Komatsu broadcast false intel claiming the entire site was destroyed, hoping to throw the invaders off their trail.

It worked—until now.

The Clanners have seen through the ruse. I just received an emergency SOS: the Smoke Jaguars are moving in to seize the depot. That means the clock is ticking.

If those Jaguars get their claws on it, we lose everything.
I still have a few favors I can call in with the DCMS. I’ll try to rally support from the Kabah Guards at the palace, but no promises.

We need that data packet to complete the picture, Commander.

misiones.resumen: Fight your way to the vault entrance
misiones.briefing:
Commander,

Before your arrival, I ordered Markson’s Marauders to secure a landing site within range of the vault facility. I just received a sitrep from Markson—they managed to lock one down, but not long after, Clan forces emerged. They call themselves the Diamond Sharks.

It’s clear they detected our approach. They were lying in wait—like predators smelling blood.

The ground between your LZ and the vault is crawling with Sharks. You and the Marauders will have to punch through to reach the entrance.

I’ve made it clear to Markson: getting you to that vault is their top priority. Nik had access to the facility, and we’ll need your father’s codes to breach it. So don’t take unnecessary risks. Let the Marauders take point and absorb the heat. If you don’t make it to that door, this entire operation goes down the drain.

I’d love to say “no pressure,” but you’re about to walk straight into it.

Good luck out there.

misiones.resumen: Fend off the Diamond Sharks
misiones.briefing:
Commander,

You told me to keep an eye on the horizon—well, the horizon just got swallowed by Diamond Shark forces, and they’re headed straight for us!

Spears and his team are still pulling data from inside, but I’ve ordered him to wrap it up. We can’t leave the DropShips exposed and expect to make it out alive.

There’s no avoiding a fight—but you need to make a break for those DropShips if we’re going to escape this facility intact.

And based on what Spears pulled from the prisoners, they’re likely not sending washed-up vets or cannon fodder. These are elite warriors—fast, deadly, and coming in hard.

I know you’ve lost a step, Commander—but now’s the time to burn whatever speed you’ve got left in the tank. Get moving!

misiones.resumen: Advance to the extraction site
misiones.briefing:
Commander,

Had enough of a breather? Because the Diamond Sharks are flooding the area—I’d say that’s our cue to get moving.

Thanks to you and Markson keeping them occupied, Spears and his team made it to the DropShips undetected.

Now it’s your turn. They won’t stop coming until you reach the extraction point—and they’ll do everything they can to keep you grounded.

So move fast, Commander. I’ve got no intention of leaving this system without you.

misiones.resumen: Intercept Smoke Jaguar Raiders
misiones.briefing:
Commander Mason, I am Tai-Sa Jim Nicholas, CO of the DCMS’ Second Dieron Regulars. I understand you’re here to help us with the SLDF's upcoming offensive? We’re currently scheduled to receive our first guests from the Capellan Confederation sometime later this month. Shiao-zhang Dehringé and I wish to run some coordinated drills and prepare ourselves for the fighting ahead. But there has been an unforeseen complication.
 
A Smoke Jaguar raiding party from Delta Galaxy’s Nineteenth Striker Cluster has been in system the past two weeks harassing the militia. Unfortunately, this is all too common an occurrence this far coreward of the Tukayyid Truce Line.

With Clan Smoke Jaguar taking heavy losses on Luthien and Tukayyid, we know raids like this one aren’t meant to conquer. Instead, they are used to blood new warriors, systematically prod our defenses, and relieve boredom for the older generation of warriors wasting away waiting for their Clan to renew the invasion. Normally, this is a nuisance that the DCMS has learned to deal with. But with Matamoras being one of the SLDF’s rallying points, we now have operational security to be concerned about. So, these raiders need to go.
 
I know you are currently contracted with the Federated Commonwealth, but these Jaguars will never know that. Seeing how Mercs along the Combine border with the Clan OZ is very common these days. So, let's get this done and pave the way for the rest of the SLDF to come.

misiones.resumen: Setup to Ambush the Jaguars
misiones.briefing:
A promising start, but the Jaguars are rarely ones to make things easy. While you were out on assignment, the Nineteenth Strike Cluster came down hard on my Second Dieron. My guys are staging a fighting withdrawal from their current position, but with the Jag’s superior tech, they can maintain speed while sniping my guys from range. The Jaguars smell blood and are trying to pick the Regulars apart piece by piece. But their sadism is only matched by their arrogance.

They are clearly spreading their line thin as they attempt to chase us down, which means there is an opportunity to blindside them.  I’ve forwarded your Ops Commander coordinates for an intercept point if the Jaguars continue their current trajectory. We’ll withdraw past your position and bait the Jaguars into a kill box for you to hit them hard in the flank. Smash into them hard enough, and it should send the raiders packing.

misiones.resumen: Scout Nova Cat Lines
misiones.briefing:
Gentlemen, despite my rousing speech before our jump, I need to report that our battlegroup’s initial target won’t be Clan Smoke Jaguar. It will be a world occupied by Clan Nova Cat. While Clan Smoke Jaguar may officially be the SLDF’s only target, secretly, Precentor Martial Focht and Coordinator Kurita have been in diplomatic talks with Nova Cat Khan Severn Leroux. There is a remote chance that Clan Nova Cat is willing to stand down and join the Star League Defense Force. As the reformation of the SLDF has always been the Clans’ larger objective in their invasion.

We hoped that they would stand down without a fight. But unfortunately, the Nova Cats of Jeanette do not seem to be playing along.  We issued a Batchall for a trial of possession for Jeanette, and the Nova Cats have responded in kind, intent on defending the world with an entire cluster’s worth of warriors. However, they will allow us to land uncontested.

Coordinator Kurita does not wish to antagonize the Nova Cats, as they could become valuable allies against the Jaguars or the other Clans. So, we will not use our vastly superior force to stamp them out. We will honor their laws and customs and meet them in the field of battle with an appropriately sized force that does not violate their customs. Commander, you and my Second Dieron will participate in the upcoming battle. House Dài Dá Chì and the rest of the combat group will remain as our reserve force in orbit.

Before we commit to any fight with the Nova Cats, we should scout their lines and see what we’re dealing with. Prep your team to execute a recon mission.

misiones.resumen: Destroy Nova Cat Forces
misiones.briefing:
Thanks to our scouting teams, we understand the Cat’s current positions and key infrastructure. Given our superior numbers compared to the Cats, I’m assigning each company their own key targets. With our superior numbers, the Nova Cats will either be forced to spread their lines thin, attempting to protect key objectives or concede territory to concentrate their forces. 

This plan isn’t without its own risks. With their superior technology and lifetime of training for war, the Nova Cats could easily punch a hole through our positions if they concentrate their forces. Or outduel us if they are smart enough to leverage their superior speed to perform hit-and-run attacks. We cannot afford to give them that chance. Approach with caution to make sure you are not coming across a concentrated Nova Cat line, but if you do see any isolated enemy stars, smash into them and punish their arrogance. 

Good hunting, everyone.

misiones.resumen: Eliminate Star Colonel Nostra
misiones.briefing:
Through captured bondsmen, we have uncovered the identity of the Nova Cat’s commander. One Star Colonel Gregor Nostra. Said to be piloting a second-line ‘Mech designed by the Nova Cats called a “Supernova.” 

We don’t have an exact position on him, but we know the general area he is said to be. So, the order of the day is going to be to encircle this perimeter to prevent Nostra and the remaining Nova Cats from escaping until we gain solid intel on his last known position. 

Nostra is said to be a hardline crusader, but not all the personnel he commands share his political views. So, taking him out may be the catalyst we need to allow cooler heads to take charge and negotiate a surrender. While it's not guaranteed that the Nova Cats will stand down after taking out Nostra, it’s a risk worth taking. We have a long fight with the Jaguars ahead of us. We can’t afford to compromise our upcoming role in BULLDOG just because of a few unruly Nova Cats.

misiones.resumen: Establish a Beachhead on Hanover
misiones.briefing:
Nearly 500 years ago, the Star League joined all six of the Great Houses to launch the single largest war in human history: the Reunification War. A war to bring then all known human space under the banner of the collective Star League. It was the last time that the Great Houses put aside their differences to fight side-by-side under the banner of the Star League for the collective betterment of all mankind. That is… until today. 

Hanover was one of the worlds targeted by Operation BIRD DOG. A top-secret operation that took volunteer ‘Mech companies to stage protracted guerrilla campaigns to draw the Jaguars away from the worlds targeted by BULLDOG's opening wave. Swift Spirits Company from the DCMS First Ghost Regiment was assigned to Hanover. Our guys have been in-system for the past three months doing everything they can to infuriate and disrupt Jaguar defenders and give us the opportunity we have today. BIRD DOG was estimated to be a high-casualty operation. So today, we need to do our part and make sure their sacrifices were not in vain. 

Though our brothers and sisters in the SLDF have already drawn blood against Clan Smoke Jaguar while we tangled with the Nova Cats, it is now our turn to finally join the fight. Stay sharp, stand tall, and support your brothers in the SLDF to see this bloody task done. Though we each serve different masters and though our homes are light-years apart, in this war, our goals are aligned. Support each other, regardless of race, creed, or nationality, and let's show these Jaguars what a truly unified Inner Sphere looks like!

Commander Mason and the Crater Cobras will be the tip of our spear and will establish a beachhead for the 2nd Dieron and House Dài Dá Chì. Give them hell.

misiones.resumen: Hunt Down Jaguar Commanders
misiones.briefing:
We have our foothold; all the pieces are in place. All that is left is our opening engagement with the Smoke Jaguars.

I won’t lie to you, gentlemen; the Jaguars are dangerous prey. And they will fight to the last man to ensure that we do not take what they see as theirs. But they are not unbeatable. The DCMS beat them on Luthien. The Com Guards beat them on Tukayyid. And we will beat them here. I won’t deny that those victories didn’t come without heavy tolls, but each of them cost the Jaguars more. And through our vigilance, we have a chance to rid the universe of their kind for good.

Despite attempting to contact the BIRD DOG operatives, we can only assume that their silence means that they are all captured or KIA. The Second Dieron and House Dài Dá Chì will be on point to receive the Jaguars head-on. The Crater Cobras and Commander Mason will act as head-hunters. ICC will attempt to identify the Jaguars’ chain of command, and the mercenaries will attempt to cut off the Jaguars’ head while the body is occupied with the House Regiments.

Cobras, you will be with me. Mason, you and yours will be working with House Dài Dá Chì. Shiao-zhang Dehringé will take point on your front.

Time to give these bastards a taste of who we truly are!

misiones.resumen: Destroy Smoke Jaguar Bases
misiones.briefing:
Commander Mason, House Dài Dá Chì took some significant losses after your withdrawal from the field, and the Jaguars have noticed. They seem to be amassing a large force for a major offensive push against Dài Dá Chì’s lines.

Their hasty pivot to exploit a supposed weakness in our line has left a pair of small Jaguar bases particularly vulnerable. And we believe we have an opportunity to exploit that vulnerability with a counteroffensive.
 
The Crater Cobras have been assigned to march on the bases in plain view of the Jaguars. We believe that this will pull out what little defenders the base has and allow for a quick strike unit to take the base out. That is where you come in.

I know you are still in the process of recovering but given the tight window we have on this target of opportunity, I need to call upon you once more. The Crater Cobras will pull as many of the defenders as they can away from the facilities, which should give you a window to attack with minimal resistance.
 
Good hunting, Commander.

misiones.resumen: Save the Crater Cobras
misiones.briefing:
Commander, the Crater Cobras are in trouble. When the offensive advancing on House Dài Dá Chì saw the Cobras advance, they pivoted their line to collectively come down on the Cobras’ heads. Colonel Stephan Prynne made it out, but one of his battalions under Captain Shelly Trudeau has been forced to the ground.

They are currently held up in a series of civilian buildings, but their ‘Mechs are badly damaged, and they need assistance. I’m currently en route to support, but you are in a more immediate position to assist.

I need you to link up with them and reinforce their position while the second lines up to stage a proper evacuation. It's time to step up, Commander. Don’t let the SLDF down.

misiones.resumen: Destroy Jaguars' Strategic Targets
misiones.briefing:
I know we’ve driven some rough road to get here, but CIC is finally seeing signs that Smoke Jaguar attrition is setting in. The Jags are the most savage and vicious combatants the Inner Sphere has ever seen. But while that ferocity all but guarantees any battle with them will leave you bloody, if you weather their onslaught of raw aggression, battle fatigue will eventually hit them. Hard.
 
We’re starting to see that now, so it's time to go on the offensive against key logistics targets and finally break the Jaguar’s hold on Hanover for good. 

Finish strong, Commander. We still have a long war ahead of us.

misiones.resumen: Establish a Foothold on Bangor
misiones.briefing:
Commander, Tai-sa Nicholas is indisposed at the moment so I’m here to provide you with a sitrep.
 
Our jump into the Bangor system was initially quiet, but we’ve found that elements of the Smoke Jaguar Navy are blockading Bangor IV. This system’s only inhabited world. A red alert was called, and the SLDF Navy has been ordered to break through the Jaguar Navy and make a run for Bangor IV. The Ryu-Gekido and DCMS Aerospace wings will carve us a path, but our lone Leopard is still going to need to blockade run through those WarShips to get to the system.
 
We’ll likely be safer than the larger Unions and Overlords joining our blockade run, but I’ll still need you to suit up and prepare for this next combat drop to be as hot as it gets. Once we prep your 'Mechs, Fahad will encase them in orbital drop cocoons as a precaution. Just in case we need to vent you before we hit Bangor’s atmosphere. Pray we don’t need them.
 
Tai-sa Nicholas is preoccupied with working with the SLDF Navy to get us a path to the surface, but he promises he’ll report in once we’re on the ground.
  
Strap in, Commander. This is bound to be a rough ride.

misiones.resumen: Hold the SLDF Flanks
misiones.briefing:
I wish I had more definitive news about our naval engagements, but unfortunately, I don’t. The SLDF fleet took a lot of heat clearing a path for our DropShips. The Ryu-Gekido has been damaged, but its engines are still in working order. It's currently withdrawn to the far side of Bangor IV, out of direct Line of Sight from the Osis’ Fury. The Essex-class ship is giving chase. 

The one silver lining is that if the Ryu-Gekido preoccupies the Jaguar Navy playing cat and mouse, the larger our window becomes to act with impunity down here on the surface. In better news, we received word shortly before our Jump that Bangor’s primary defenders, the Second Jaguar Regulars, are currently preoccupied raiding the system of McAlister. So, while we don’t have exact numbers on Bangor’s defenders, we know they are already down an entire ‘Mech Galaxy.  

Commander Mason, while I am sorry to hear about your DropShip troubles, unfortunately, your damage is not an isolated incident. We’ve already had several ‘Mech carriers damaged or destroyed attempting to run the Jaguar’s blockade. Best I can do is assign your Mercs to guard our western flank as House Dài Dá Chì and I attempt to quickly push and claim Bangor’s capital city, Reega.

Let's look to close this out as soon as we can. We should assume that HPG communiques have already been sent to the Second Jaguar Regulars, alerting them of our invasion, so we need to secure this system before they return from their raid on McAlister.

misiones.resumen: Take Control of Bangor's HPG
misiones.briefing:
The Jaguars have proven to be more stubborn than we thought. Our advance on Reega has stalled, and I’m afraid that blockading the city is risky with the threat of the Second Jaguar Regulars returning from McAlister looking for a fight. We’re also seeing several smaller Smoke Jaguar JumpShips and DropShips entering our system, fleeing from the worlds liberated during the opening waves of BULLDOG and likely providing a small trickle of reinforcements to the Jaguar defenders. And that’s not even accounting for our dueling Navies still hunting each other above our heads.

While I have full confidence in this group to take the field as conditions currently stand, with so many X factors in play, I think we need to call in reinforcements. Just in case things take a turn for the worse.
 
But to do that, we’ll need to wrest Bangor’s HPG from the Smoke Jaguars. So that has become our primary objective. Mason, since you have the compromised DropShip, you’ll take point before the fighting gets too hot. Shiao-Zhang Dehringé and I will be right behind you. We’re all hands-on deck for this one, SLDF. Let’s make First Lord Liao proud.

misiones.resumen: Hold the Line
misiones.briefing:
Bangor’s HPG facility is now secure. Our ComStar attaché has sent a priority message directly to Precentor Martial Focht; all we need to do now is sit tight and do what we can to receive reinforcements.
 
The Smoke Jaguars must know their window to get rid of us is closing fast. So, we know they’ll respond in some way. I’ve ordered the SLDF to take positions across several temporary FOBs surrounding the HPG facility. We only need to garrison these bases and repel anything the Jaguars throw our way. 

At this point, we win by staying alive and retaining control of the system’s HPG till reinforcements arrive. Hold the line, and don’t let any Jaguars through.

misiones.resumen: Rescue Survivors
misiones.briefing:
Everyone! The Ryu-Gekido has been blown into the atmosphere! The captain’s final transmission said that he was scuttling the ship and ordering everyone to life pods.
 
Those life pods are designed to survive re-entry. But given how late the order was given, I doubt that many can be that far from the Gekido’s crash site. 

Shiao-Zhang Dehringé and House Dài Dá Chì will take command of the HPG garrison. Mason, you’re with me. I know the chances of finding survivors are incredibly slim, but I do not intend to leave our men to fend for themselves against the Smoke Jaguars or Bangor’s wilderness. We MUST try and save whoever we can. Mount up!

misiones.resumen: Destroy Remaining Smoke Jaguars
misiones.briefing:
Gentlemen. Shiao-Zhang Dehringé and I are here to give you all an updated sitrep.

As many of you know, Star Colonel Hampton Schroeder has arrived with his First Wolf Strike Grenadiers. The exiled Wolves have been held back from early waves of BULLDOG as a reserve force if other Clans involved themselves in our trial of annihilation with the Jaguars. Now, I can’t tell you why the other Clans have so far decided to sit this fight out. But their absence from this conflict has freed up the four clusters Clan Wolf contributed to the SLDF to offer reinforcements. 

They have already made short work of the remaining Smoke Jaguar Navy and are now launching DropShips to begin their orbital insertion. As one would expect from a Clanner, Star Colonel Schroeder intends to end this fight quickly by dropping directly on top of the Jaguars. He wants us to secure the Wolves an LZ to bring this conflict to a swift end. So, mount up, prepare for a fight, and stay safe out there. We’re close to the finish line with this one.

misiones.resumen: Eliminate Smoke Jaguar Leadership
misiones.briefing:
Gentlemen, Welcome to Albiero. Once the capital of the Combine’s Albiero Prefecture, it was captured by the Smoke Jaguars. With reports from across the front pointing to the Jaguars beginning to withdraw their forces into the periphery, Albiero is considered a vital target. In the Star League era, it housed a rare Jump Ship recharge station, making the world a key logistics hub.

While the recharge station was sabotaged and later mothballed in the Succession Wars, it appears that Clan Smoke Jaguar has repaired the station and reinforced the world’s logistics infrastructure. Taking this world from the Jaguars should outright destroy the last of their Clan’s major supply hubs. 

The ISF reports that Albiero’s garrison is typically the Eleventh Jaguar Regulars. But with Jaguar survivors being pushed back, we do not have an accurate picture of potential ad hoc clusters defending this world.  They have assembled a kill list for us and believe that should these individuals be removed, the Jaguars will either stand down or fall back like many other units. I’m assigning each combat unit a priority target to hunt down. If all goes well, we can make quick work of the garrison assigned here.

misiones.resumen: Stop Smoke Jaguars Escape
misiones.briefing:
House Dài Dá Chì has uncovered an enemy communique from ilKhan Lincoln Osis. He has called for all Jaguars to fall back to the Clan’s deep periphery holdings and calls on all front-line galaxies to fall back to Huntress. The Smoke Jaguar homeworld. 

This message was only delivered in the past few days. So we have a VERY narrow window in which to act to disrupt and pick off as many retreating Jaguars as possible before they make it off world. Any facility that can refuel and launch a DropShip has become our current, and possibly final, target. 

While it is impossible to stop all the rats from fleeing their sinking ship, we will make them bleed as much as possible before they do it. Every Jaguar asset we remove from the board today is one less weapon that they will have when we chase them into the periphery and put them out of their misery for good. 

Finish strong, finish clean, and we guarantee not only BULLDOG’s victory here today, but the operations that follow us that will ensure the true annihilation of Clan Smoke Jaguar.
